meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Monthly figures are provisional and revised when the quarterly BoP is compiled; BoP quarters move from preliminary to partially revised. The latest version of each period is kept.
meta.coverage: All India, services trade by BPM6 category and sub-item, credit (exports), debit (imports) and net, quarterly, US$ million; goods and the goods-and-services total for context
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1076, standard presentation of the balance of payments (BPM6). Quarters dated at their first month (Q1 = April). For each quarter the most mature version is kept; meta.versions names it for the services total. The external guide owns the balance of payments as a whole; this bundle is its services detail.
